import time


class TokenBucket:
    def __init__(self, rate, burst, clock=time.monotonic):
        self.rate = rate
        self.burst = burst
        self.clock = clock
        self.tokens = float(burst)
        self.last = clock()

    def allow(self, n=1):
        now = self.clock()
        self.tokens = min(float(self.burst), self.tokens + (now - self.last) * self.rate)
        if self.tokens >= n:
            self.tokens -= n
            return True
        return False
